verdict.rationale: LiveKit's first-party Egress docs show server-side recording of rooms to MP4 files or HLS segments, including automatic recording when a room is created and passthrough track export. Nothing in the pack shows those files being uploaded to a developer-owned storage bucket, so only half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented upload to the customer's own storage bucket (e.g. S3/GCS/Azure destinations), bucket credential configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: It supports recording to an MP4 file or HLS segments, as well as exporting to live streaming services like YouTube Live, Twitch, and Facebook via RTMP.
It starts recording automatically when a room is created.
To export a single video track without transcoding, set the `PASSTHROUGH` encoding preset, which writes the track in its native container.
